description: Find the right contract for a token symbol or name across Ethereum, Base, Solana, BNB, Arbitrum, Polygon, Optimism and Avalanche, safely: each match is labelled verified (curated lists), likely-real, unverified or likely-impostor (copycat of the same symbol), with liquidity, 24h volume, price and age. Also accepts an address. Price: $0.003 in USDC per call (x402 or prepaid credits). In the free trial.

query.description: Symbol (PEPE, $WIF), name (Pepe) or a contract address.

name: token-lookup

ambiguous.description: True when several different tokens could be meant: check the chain and address.

ambiguousChains.description: Chains with more than one verified or likely-real match.

best.description: The most trustworthy match (verified first, then liquidity, volume and age).

candidates.description: All matches, safest first: chain, address, name, symbol, status (verified, likely-real, unverified, likely-impostor), lists, liquidity, volume, price, first pool date, warnings.

perChain.description: Best verified or likely-real address on each chain.

title: Token lookup ($0.003)
